def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # 1. Позиции, купленные строго до seed_time
    items = order_items[order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) &
                        (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)]
    if items.empty:
        base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
        return base.fillna(0)

    # Информация о заказе: используем только то, что уже известно на seed_time
    ord_cols = orders[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status',
                       'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
                       'order_delivered_carrier_date',
                       'order_delivered_customer_date',
                       'order_estimated_delivery_date']]
    items = items.merge(ord_cols, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Статус/даты видимы, только если событие уже произошло до seed_time
    st = items['order_purchase_timestamp']
    items['is_approved'] = ((items['order_approved_at'].notna()) &
                            (items['order_approved_at'] < seed_time)).astype(float)
    items['is_shipped'] = ((items['order_delivered_carrier_date'].notna()) &
                           (items['order_delivered_carrier_date'] < seed_time)).astype(float)
    items['is_delivered'] = ((items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna()) &
                             (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)).astype(float)
    items['is_canceled'] = ((items['order_status'] == 'canceled') &
                            (st < seed_time)).astype(float)
    items['purchase_lag_days'] = (seed_time - st).dt.days

    # Оценка задержки доставки известна всегда (оценка делается при покупке),
    # но фактическая задержка — только если доставка уже случилась
    est = items['order_estimated_delivery_date']
    items['est_delivery_lag_days'] = (est - st).dt.days
    delivered_mask = items['is_delivered'] == 1
    items['actual_delivery_lag_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - st).dt.days,
        np.nan)
    items['delivered_late'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] > est), 1.0, np.nan)

    # 2. Отзывы: видимы только те, что созданы до seed_time
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby('order_id').agg(
        mean_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        min_score=('review_score', 'min'),
        cnt_review=('review_score', 'count')
    ).reset_index()

    # 3. Платежи: видимы только те, что произошли до seed_time
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        sum_paid=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
        mean_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        n_pay_types=('payment_type', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # 4. Базовая агрегация по всей истории до seed_time
    base = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        cnt_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        mean_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        mean_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        mean_review_score=('mean_score', 'mean'),
        min_review_score=('min_score', 'min'),
        cnt_reviews=('cnt_review', 'sum'),
        sum_paid=('sum_paid', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('cnt_payments', 'sum'),
        mean_installments=('mean_installments', 'mean'),
        n_pay_types=('n_pay_types', 'mean'),
        is_approved=('is_approved', 'mean'),
        is_shipped=('is_shipped', 'mean'),
        is_delivered=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
        is_canceled=('is_canceled', 'mean'),
        mean_purchase_lag=('purchase_lag_days', 'mean'),
        mean_est_delivery_lag=('est_delivery_lag_days', 'mean'),
        mean_actual_delivery_lag=('actual_delivery_lag_days', 'mean'),
        delivered_late_rate=('delivered_late', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    # 5. Оконные признаки за последние 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365 дней
    for N in [14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        sub = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=N)]
        g = sub.groupby('product_id')
        ord_cnt = g['order_id'].nunique()
        rev_sum = g['price'].sum()
        cust_cnt = g['customer_id'].nunique()
        mean_price = g['price'].mean()
        idx = base['product_id']
        base[f'orders_{N}d'] = ord_cnt.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'revenue_{N}d'] = rev_sum.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'customers_{N}d'] = cust_cnt.reindex(idx, fill_value=0).values
        base[f'mean_price_{N}d'] = mean_price.reindex(idx).values

    # 6. Возраст продукта и время с последней покупки
    first_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min()
    last_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max()
    idx = base['product_id']
    base['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - first_ts.reindex(idx)).dt.days.values
    base['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - last_ts.reindex(idx)).dt.days.values

    # 7. Приводим к полному списку экземпляров
    base = base.set_index('product_id').reindex(entity_ids)
    base = base.fillna(0)

    return base
